title: Suspicious Kerberos Ticket Lifetime Variant
content: Windows security logs show Kerberos tickets with abnormal lifetime and RC4 encryption for privileged accounts. Requests originate from a workstation that is not a domain controller.

expected.threat_summary: Kerberos ticket properties suggest forged or abnormal ticket use against privileged identities.
key_behaviors: Kerberos ticket lifetime or encryption is abnormal
source host is not expected for domain administration
mitre_mapping: T1558 - Steal or Forge Kerberos Tickets
hunt_checklist: Review Kerberos 4768/4769/4770 events for abnormal ticket lifetime, encryption, and krbtgt/service use.
Identify account, source host, domain controller, service principal, ticket options, and encryption type.
Confirm whether the source host is expected to request privileged Kerberos tickets.
expected.correlation_logic: Correlate Kerberos events by account, source host, domain controller, service principal, ticket properties, and time window.
expected.escalation_condition: Escalate when abnormal Kerberos ticket behavior targets privileged identities from an unexpected host.
expected.analyst_notes: Hand-authored external gold standard case for accuracy/generalization evaluation.
